result.summary: The page is mostly functional, but there are a few visible defects: a missing/broken restaurant image in the 'Popular right now' section, a truncated restaurant name, cut-off category chips, and a bottom card that is partially hidden.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing in 'Popular right now' displays a gray broken-image placeholder with a crossed-out picture icon instead of the actual restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source/asset path or provide a proper fallback placeholder so the card does not look broken.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list is truncated, indicating the card width or text handling is too restrictive.
issues.suggestion: Increase card width, allow text wrapping, or use a better truncation/ellipsis treatment so names remain readable.

issues.description: The horizontal category chips on the right are cut off ('Healthy' is partially visible and additional categories may be hidden).
issues.suggestion: Add right padding or a fade/scroll indicator to the chip list so the truncation is intentional and visually complete.

issues.description: The bottom pizza/restaurant card is partially cut off at the bottom of the screen, making the content appear broken or incomplete before scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding or a scroll-safe area so the last card is fully visible above the navigation bar.
